queries.query: Deciding whether to regenerate or replace PFAS adsorption media. Prepare a focused review of the evidence needed to choose among regeneration, replacement, and end-of-life management for PFAS-loaded adsorption media.
Compare regeneration approaches by PFAS release or destruction, recovered capacity, repeated-cycle performance, and material deterioration.
Account for liquid, gaseous, or solid residuals and distinguish transfer of PFAS from actual destruction.
Evaluate the operational, energy, chemical, cost, and sustainability evidence needed for a site-specific decision.
